tasks.subject: Move network feed slots array to PSRAM heap
tasks.description: Change feed_slot_context_t slots[APP_MAX_FEED_SLOTS] to a pointer in network_context_t, allocate in app_network_start via heap_caps_malloc(MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM) with MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL fallback. Frees ~88KB static DRAM to fix 37.7KB overflow.
tasks.activeForm: Moving feed slots to PSRAM heap

tasks.subject: Build firmware and verify DRAM headroom
tasks.description: Run idf.py -C firmware build, capture to work/idf-build.log, verify SUCCESS, run idf.py size, report DRAM/flash numbers and warning count.

tasks.description: Run make test from repo root with GOCACHE=$(pwd)/work/gocache — must be green.
